title: goaly config file (.goalyrc)
description: Default CLI flags for goaly runs, keyed by kebab-case flag name. Resolution order: tool default < ~/.goalyrc < <workspace>/.goalyrc < --config file < CLI flag. Booleans are presence-style: true sets the flag, false means "not set". Unknown keys are a hard usage error (fail-closed).
